operations.title: Paired polarization has a conditional metaplectic phase matching the missing one-eighth
operations.statement: For a finite regular coefficient-Betti fiber, the delta identification defines a canonical symplectic exchange J(c,b)=(-b,c) with J^2=-1. After real extension, the positive-path square root exp(pi J/4) has one-mode metaplectic half-form phase exp(-i*pi/8), exactly the missing -1/8 smooth-count correction. No admitted Carrier map yet selects this half-rotation as the dual-cutoff boundary path, so the match is conditional.
operations.scope: Canonical algebraic polarization exchange and conditional archimedean phase; no physical chain realization, xi determinant, or zero spectrum.

operations.title: Paired metaplectic eighth-phase test
operations.procedure: Verify the delta identification is natural, compute J^2 and symplectic invariance, exponentiate J through angle pi/4, and calculate the one-mode half-form phase along the identity-based metaplectic lift.
operations.expected_result: The phase is exp(-i*pi/8) and contributes -1/8 to counting. Failure of symplecticity or a different path phase falsifies the candidate.
